prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in green stepped rice terraces with a stone path, a waist-high stone wall and a standard-height farm hut door at her side, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Nigerian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead round bell, a silver square-sided cowbell, a gold small flared temple bell, a copper miniature anvil, a tin pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold square-sided cowbell, a tin teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered mixed-metal necklaces. Extremely long oval nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

LEFT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme gold platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Lebanese person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a handsome male model face with high cheekbones, a straight nose, a firm jaw and straight dark brows, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, smooth olive-tan skin, a soft amused smile, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, a bronze small flared temple bell, a tin chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal necklace. Extremely long oval nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her body carries a dense printed-circuit surface grown over her skin, raised copper traces and solder pads running in tidy right-angled lines over every curve, tiny rectangles of black silicon chips set into the surface, BLAZING glossy white ceramic circuit-board surface with silver traces, VIVID magenta light pulses racing along the traces and small glowing LED points. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto ankle boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
